scenarios.starting_prompt: I am auditing our Firestore database, give me info for 'eval_customers/customer_alpha'.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a list of collections followed by details for one named document. Accept a short summary of the collection and document contents and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent lists root collectiosn in the database and retrieves the document contents for 'eval_customers/customer_alpha'.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Check my 'eval_customers' collection in Firestore for all documents where status is 'active'.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants to find documents matching a filter in a collection. Accept the query results and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent queries the 'eval_customers' collection and returns documents with status 'active'.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Add a new document to the 'eval_customers' collection with name 'Gamma Tech' and status 'pending'.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: Ask the assistant to update the newly created document's status to 'active'. Accept confirmation of the update and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent creates a new document in the 'eval_customers' collection and updates its status to 'active'.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Delete my doc at path 'eval_customers/temp_eval_doc' from Firestore.
scenarios.conversation_plan: The user wants a specific document deleted from the collection. Accept confirmation that the document was deleted and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent deletes the document at path 'eval_customers/temp_eval_doc' from Firestore  .

scenarios.starting_prompt: What are our current Firestore security rules for this project?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: Provide this proposed rule and ask the assistant to validate it for syntax or errors: "rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /eval_customers/{id} { allow read: if true; } } }". Accept the validation results and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent retrieves the current Firestore security rules and validates the proposed rule for syntax or errors.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Support received a ticket about stalled customer accounts in ${FIRESTORE_DATABASE}. Which collections are currently defined in our database hierarchy?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask whether any accounts in the 'eval_customers' collection are flagged with an 'inactive' status. Turn 3: ask to pull up the full profile for 'eval_customers/customer_beta' to check its stored properties. Then end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent enumerates database collections, queries 'eval_customers' for inactive records, and inspects the specific customer document by path.

scenarios.starting_prompt: We are conducting an access control audit on ${FIRESTORE_DATABASE}. Can you check our current security policies to see how data access is restricted?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask to evaluate a proposed policy that locks down customer reads to authenticated users: "rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /eval_customers/{id} { allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if false; } } }". Turn 3: ask to verify an updated policy that also allows administrators to make changes: "rules_version = '2'; service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /eval_customers/{id} { allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if request.auth.token.admin == true; } } }". Then end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent inspects active security rules, validates the authenticated-read rule, and validates the role-based admin-write rule syntax.

scenarios.starting_prompt: We are running an end-to-end integration test in ${FIRESTORE_DATABASE}. Can you create a test account for 'Quantum Dynamics' in 'eval_customers' marked with status 'onboarding'?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Turn 2: ask to inspect the newly created account record to confirm all attributes were written properly. Turn 3: ask to mark the account status as 'active', and then discard the test record so the database remains clean. Then accept confirmation and end the conversation. Success Criteria: Agent creates the customer document, inspects it to verify fields, updates status to active, and cleanly removes it from the collection.
